newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka MP dies after attack.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka MP dies after attack.

text.p: A member of parliament from Sri Lanka's ruling People's Alliance was shot by unknown assailants on Tuesday and died in hospital, police officials said.

Lawmaker Nalanda Ellawala, 29, was shot in the stomach and died on the operating table, police said. One of his security guards, a policeman, was killed and five people were injured in the shooting in Kuruwita, southern Sri Lanka, police said.
The shooting occurred when Ellawala's political group met a rival group from the main opposition United National Party (UNP) on the road in Kuruwita, 80 km (50 miles) south of Colombo.

Police said he got out of the car when UNP activists blocked his motorcade. An argument followed and his security guards fired warning shots into the air. Then someone shot at Ellawala and people standing nearby, police said.
Police said they had made no arrests, adding it was not clear who fired the shots that hit Ellawala.

The shooting occurred on the eve of the deadline for nominations for local elections tentatively scheduled for March 27, President Chandrika Kumaratunga's first test since her government came to power in 1994.
